en.title: Zelenskyy-Putin war of words after Trump remarks
en.dek: Denmark expelled a Russian diplomat over an alleged assassination plot while Ukrainian and Russian leaders traded verbal jabs.
facts: Denmark expelled a Russian defense attaché following allegations of a plot to kill a US-Ukrainian citizen in Copenhagen.
The Russian embassy in Denmark denied the assassination plot accusation.
A ballistic missile strike on Kryvyi Rih killed two people and wounded 60.
A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Gulf of Finland.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called Russian leader Vladimir Putin a 'killer'.
US President Donald Trump stated he and Putin share a 'great relationship'.
body: Denmark expelled a Russian defense attaché following allegations of a plot to assassinate a US-Ukrainian citizen in Copenhagen, according to reports from France 24 and the BBC. The Russian embassy in Denmark denied the accusation.
Al Jazeera reported that the targeted individual in the alleged plot was a Ukrainian rapper.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy referred to Russian leader Vladimir Putin as a 'killer', as reported by the BBC and Euronews.

The remark by Zelenskyy followed statements made by US President Donald Trump, who greeted Putin ahead of a meeting in China and stated that the pair have a 'great relationship', according to BBC and Euronews coverage.

A ballistic missile attack on Kryvyi Rih killed two people and wounded 60, according to Al Jazeera and AP News. The strike targeted civilian infrastructure, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated.
A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea, according to France 24 and Euronews. Finnish officials reported the vessel was struck in the Gulf of Finland.
Russian President Vladimir Putin called Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy a 'clown' and 'dictator', according to reports from multiple outlets.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he is ready for talks with Putin without preconditions, as reported by Euronews.
The diplomatic expulsions and verbal exchanges occur against the backdrop of ongoing international tensions involving Russia, Ukraine, and Western nations.
en.context: International tensions involving Russia, Ukraine, and Western nations have intensified following recent diplomatic and military actions.

de.dek: Dänemark hat einen russischen Diplomaten wegen eines mutmaßlichen Mordkomplotts ausgewiesen, während die Führungspersönlichkeiten der Ukraine und Russlands Wortgefechte führten.
body: Dänemark hat Berichten von France 24 und der BBC zufolge einen russischen Verteidigungsattaché ausgewiesen, nachdem Vorwürfe laut geworden waren, ein Anschlag auf einen US-ukrainisch-stämmigen Staatsbürger in Kopenhagen sei geplant gewesen. Die russische Botschaft in Dänemark wies die Anschuldigung zurück.
Al Jazeera berichtete, dass es sich bei der Zielperson des mutmaßlichen Komplotts um einen ukrainischen Rapper handelte.
Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj bezeichnete den russischen Machthaber Wladimir Putin als 'Mörder', wie die BBC und Euronews berichteten.
Selenskyjs Äußerung folgte auf Aussagen von US-Präsident Donald Trump.
Berichten der BBC und von Euronews zufolge begrüßte Trump Putin im Vorfeld eines Treffens in China und erklärte, die beiden pflegten ein 'großartiges Verhältnis'.

US-Präsident Donald Trump erklärte, er und Putin pflegten ein 'großartiges Verhältnis'.

en.headline: Russian missile strike kills two in Kryvyi Rih
en.body: A ballistic missile attack on Kryvyi Rih killed two people and wounded 60, according to Al Jazeera and AP News. The strike targeted civilian infrastructure, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated.

de.headline: Russischer Raketenangriff fordert zwei Todesopfer in Krywyj Rih
de.body: Bei einem ballistischen Raketenangriff auf Krywyj Rih wurden nach Angaben von Al Jazeera und AP News zwei Menschen getötet und 60 weitere verletzt. Der Angriff galt ziviler Infrastruktur, wie der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj mitteilte.

fr.headline: Une frappe de missile russe fait deux morts à Kryvyi Rih
fr.body: Une attaque au missile balistique sur Kryvyi Rih a tué deux personnes et en a blessé 60, selon Al Jazeera et AP News. La frappe a visé des infrastructures civiles, a déclaré le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky.

pt.headline: Ataque com míssil russo mata duas pessoas em Kryvyi Rih
pt.body: Um ataque com míssil balístico em Kryvyi Rih matou duas pessoas e feriu 60, segundo a Al Jazeera e a AP News. O ataque visou infraestruturas civis, afirmou o presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯导弹袭击克里维里赫，造成两人死亡
zh.body: 据半岛电视台和美联社报道，克里维里赫遭到弹道导弹袭击，造成两人死亡，60人受伤。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，此次袭击针对的是民用基础设施。

it.headline: Attacco missilistico russo uccide due persone a Kryvyi Rih
it.body: Un attacco con missili balistici su Kryvyi Rih ha causato due morti e 60 feriti, secondo quanto riportato da Al Jazeera e AP News. Il raid ha colpito infrastrutture civili, ha dichiarato il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

ko.headline: 러시아 미사일 공격으로 크리비리흐에서 2명 사망
ko.body: 알자지라와 AP 통신에 따르면 크리비리흐에 대한 탄도 미사일 공격으로 2명이 사망하고 60명이 부상당했다. 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령은 이번 공격이 민간 기반 시설을 겨냥했다고 밝혔다.

es.headline: Un ataque con misiles rusos mata a dos personas en Krivói Rog
es.body: Un ataque con misiles balísticos en Krivói Rog ha causado la muerte de dos personas y ha dejado 60 heridos, según Al Jazeera y AP News. El ataque tuvo como objetivo infraestructuras civiles, según declaró el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski.

en.headline: Drone attack damages Russian cargo ship in Gulf of Finland
en.body: A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea, according to France 24 and Euronews. Finnish officials reported the vessel was struck in the Gulf of Finland.

de.headline: Drohnenangriff beschädigt russisches Frachtschiff im Finnischen Meerbusen
de.body: Ein russisches Frachtschiff fing Feuer, nachdem es in der Ostsee von Drohnen getroffen wurde, wie France 24 und Euronews berichten. Finnische Behörden meldeten, dass das Schiff im Finnischen Meerbusen getroffen wurde.

fr.headline: Une attaque de drone endommage un cargo russe dans le golfe de Finlande
fr.body: Un cargo russe a pris feu après avoir été touché par des drones dans la mer Baltique, selon France 24 et Euronews. Les autorités finlandaises ont rapporté que le navire a été frappé dans le golfe de Finlande.

pt.headline: Ataque de drones danifica navio de carga russo no Golfo da Finlândia
pt.body: Um navio de carga russo incendiou-se após ser atingido por drones no Mar Báltico, segundo a France 24 e a Euronews. As autoridades finlandesas informaram que a embarcação foi atingida no Golfo da Finlândia.

zh.headline: 无人机袭击导致一艘俄罗斯货船在芬兰湾受损
zh.body: 据法国24电视台和欧洲新闻台报道，一艘俄罗斯货船在波罗的海遭无人机袭击后起火。芬兰官员报告称，该船只在芬兰湾遇袭。

it.headline: Attacco di droni danneggia una nave cargo russa nel Golfo di Finlandia
it.body: Una nave cargo russa ha preso fuoco dopo essere stata colpita da droni nel Mar Baltico, secondo quanto riferito da France 24 ed Euronews. Le autorità finlandesi hanno segnalato che l'imbarcazione è stata colpita nel Golfo di Finlandia.

ko.headline: 핀란드만에서 드론 공격으로 러시아 화물선 파손
ko.body: 프랑스 24와 유로뉴스에 따르면 발트해에서 드론 공격을 받은 러시아 화물선에 화재가 발생했다. 핀란드 당국은 해당 선박이 핀란드만에서 피격되었다고 보고했다.

es.headline: Un ataque con drones daña un buque de carga ruso en el golfo de Finlandia
es.body: Un buque de carga ruso se incendió tras ser alcanzado por drones en el mar Báltico, según France 24 y Euronews. Las autoridades finlandesas informaron de que la embarcación fue atacada en el golfo de Finlandia.

es.body: Según la BBC y Euronews, el presidente ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, se refirió al líder ruso, Vladímir Putin, como un «asesino». El comentario se produjo tras las declaraciones del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, quien saludó a Putin antes de una reunión en China y afirmó que ambos mantienen una «gran relación».
es.headline: Zelensky califica a Putin de asesino tras los comentarios de Trump

fr.body: Selon la BBC et Euronews, le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelenskyy a qualifié le dirigeant russe Vladimir Poutine de « tueur ». Cette remarque fait suite aux déclarations du président américain Donald Trump, qui a salué Poutine avant une réunion en Chine et a affirmé que les deux hommes entretenaient une « excellente relation ».
fr.headline: Zelenskyy qualifie Poutine de tueur après les commentaires de Trump

it.body: Secondo BBC ed Euronews, il Presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelenskyy ha definito il leader russo Vladimir Putin un 'assassino'. La dichiarazione è seguita dalle affermazioni del Presidente statunitense Donald Trump, che ha salutato Putin prima di un incontro in Cina e ha dichiarato che la coppia ha un 'ottimo rapporto'.
it.headline: Zelenskyy definisce Putin un assassino dopo i commenti di Trump

ja.body: BBCとEuronewsによると、ウクライナのウォロディミル・ゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン指導者を「殺人者」と呼びました。この発言は、ドナルド・トランプ米大統領が中国での会合に先立ちプーチン氏を歓迎し、両者が「素晴らしい関係」にあると述べた後のものでした。
ja.headline: ゼレンスキー大統領、トランプ氏の発言を受けプーチン氏を「殺人者」と呼ぶ

ko.body: BBC와 Euronews에 따르면, 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령은 러시아 지도자 블라디미르 푸틴을 '살인자'라고 칭했습니다. 이 발언은 미국 대통령 도널드 트럼프가 중국 회담에 앞서 푸틴을 환영하고 두 사람이 '좋은 관계'라고 언급한 후에 나왔습니다.

pt.body: Segundo a BBC e a Euronews, o Presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskyy referiu o líder russo Vladimir Putin como um 'assassino'. O comentário ocorreu após declarações do Presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, que saudou Putin antes de uma reunião na China e afirmou que o par tem uma 'grande relação'.
